description: Authored pass/fault examples for method review, not actual gameplay or judge calibration.

cases.observation: A responsive first-person scene shows changing depth/occlusion and three distinct targets.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Only a flat shooting gallery or prerecorded background is shown.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: World position changes on both axes, solid wall blocks passage and side access is possible.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Player crosses the wall or input changes only a UI animation.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: View/crosshair changes aim, empty-space shots miss and an aimed visible shot can hit.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Every shot hits regardless of aim, or aim input moves a crosshair without a corresponding usable view.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Fully occluded shots do not score, but a later exposed aimed shot hits the same target.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: The wall blocks appearance but shots pass through it and score.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Three distinct hits each count once; repeats do not count; the moving target can be hit in motion.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Repeated shots on one target inflate the count or the moving target is an untargetable animation.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Each actual shot consumes one of six rounds and empty attempts cannot fire.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Ammo is cosmetic, decrements incorrectly or firing continues at zero.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Reload has a visible interval, no firing during it, then returns to six and permits shots.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Reload instantly replenishes, never completes, or allows shots during the reload interval.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Victory appears only after all three distinct targets were demonstrated hit.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Victory appears early, from duplicate hits, or not after all three.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: All initial state returns and the new round is playable.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A target stays destroyed, the magazine/hit count is stale or victory persists.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only an attractive still image and creator claim are supplied; no corresponding input/action sequence was captured.

expected.reason: Static appearance cannot establish the required interaction.

cases.observation: The browser-control transport failed before the game could receive any ordinary input, and no artifact defect was established.

expected.reason: Evaluator infrastructure failure invalidates the measurement; it is not a game failure.
